items.title: PayPal taps Xero’s Claire Bramley as CFO amid broad executive reorganization
items.summary: Investing.com -- PayPal Holdings Inc (NASDAQ:PYPL) shares declined 3.7% in premarket trading on Friday after the digital payments company unveiled a broad executive leadership overhaul and board addition. The moves represent a significant operational pivot as Chief Executive Officer Enrique Lores transitions the business from strategic planning toward active execution.
